candidate_name: CrowdGen by Appen with Dots payout

sources.supports: The complete current Appen public board lists country-specific and Any-location openings, including several African-country projects.
sources.does_not_establish: The board contains no Sierra Leone opening. Nearby African openings require residence in the named country, while Any-location openings still require named languages or specialist credentials; none establishes a current task for a defined Sierra Leone worker.

sources.supports: CrowdGen describes a contributor path of applying, qualifying, completing accepted work and receiving location-dependent payment.
sources.does_not_establish: Global recruitment and variable pay do not establish Sierra Leone account approval, current task inventory, acceptance probability or earnings.

sources.supports: CrowdGen says project matching depends on location and qualifications and names Dots-linked, location-dependent payout options.
sources.does_not_establish: The page does not name a current Sierra Leone project, worker acceptance receipt or CrowdGen-enabled Sierra Leone payout method.

sources.supports: CrowdGen's terms make account approval discretionary and provide the service as available without guaranteeing work.
sources.does_not_establish: The terms do not establish that a Sierra Leone resident can open an approved account, qualify for a current task or earn a positive amount.

sources.supports: CrowdGen names Dots as its payment partner, says available methods depend on country and publishes generic provider-fee examples; it warns that small payments may be held below applicable fees.
sources.does_not_establish: Exact options and pricing require account confirmation. Sierra Leone is absent from the local-bank table, and the page does not supply a Sierra Leone minimum, complete fee chain, FX basis or cash-settlement time.

sources.supports: Dots' current coverage map lists Sierra Leone push-to-card, AirTM, crypto, gift card, SWIFT USD and Payoneer rails.
sources.does_not_establish: Provider coverage does not prove that CrowdGen enables a rail for a Sierra Leone contributor. The map uses legacy SLL labels for several rails and does not identify a named eligible card, bank or wallet, minimum, fees, FX or completed local cash receipt.

sources.supports: Dots' static supported-country snapshot marks Sierra Leone local-bank transfer and tells readers to use the current coverage map as the source of truth.
sources.does_not_establish: The current map omits Sierra Leone local-bank transfer, so the snapshot is conflicting coverage evidence rather than proof of a CrowdGen-enabled bank route.

sources.supports: Dots documents multiple payout rails and notes that an application can exclude rails and set an application-specific payout minimum.
sources.does_not_establish: Generic Dots rail support cannot establish the methods CrowdGen exposes to a particular Sierra Leone contributor or the complete local spendability economics.

current_access.finding: CrowdGen recruits internationally and matches by location, but account approval is discretionary and no current Sierra Leone registration, qualification or accepted-account receipt was found.

current_demand.finding: The complete current public board has no Sierra Leone opening. Country-specific African roles cannot be generalized to Sierra Leone, and Any-location roles still require languages or credentials not tied to a defined local worker; no current task, rate and acceptance terms were verified.

worker_eligibility.finding: Published openings impose project-specific location, language, experience or qualification requirements, but no consenting Sierra Leone worker was verified as eligible for a current paid task.

spendable_payout.finding: CrowdGen verifies only a generic Dots partnership. Dots' live map names Sierra Leone rails but uses legacy SLL labels, conflicts with the static snapshot on local-bank availability, and permits application-specific exclusions and minimums. No CrowdGen-enabled rail is linked through a named eligible institution to spendable SLE with complete minimum, fees, FX and timing.

limitations: NO_VERIFIABLE_ROUTE means the current public Sierra Leone task-to-spendable-cash chain could not be completed; it is not evidence of unavailability. Hermes independently read the eight requested original sources plus two Dots references, but its terms-of-service extraction was truncated; that coverage gap is a reopen condition rather than negative proof. Provider coverage is not a completed CrowdGen payout receipt. Task reward, availability, worker qualification and acceptance, unpaid assessment time, rejection, connectivity, equipment, tax, payout minimum, provider and receiving-institution fees, SLL-to-current-SLE unit semantics, FX, cash-out and settlement time remain unknown rather than zero. No login, signup, contact, application, task attempt, spending or transaction occurred; human earnings and benefit remain zero.
next_trigger: Reopen only for a current Sierra Leone-compatible CrowdGen project plus an eligible worker receipt and an in-account Dots quote or completed local cash receipt resolving the enabled method, SLL/SLE units, minimum, all fees, FX and settlement time.
